decisions.title: Veervrat North Star: कर्तृत्वशक्तीचे स्वावलंबन
decisions.summary: Veervrat aims at progressively increasing कर्तृत्वशक्तीचे स्वावलंबन: the motivation, judgment, virtues, capacity for action, perseverance, adaptability, and self-reflection for कर्तृत्व increasingly arise from within the person, enabling meaningful and consequential action.

decisions.title: दोषापनयन fundamentally occurs through गुणसंवर्धन
decisions.summary: Development is framed through cultivating relevant गुण / उपगुण so that a corresponding lacuna gradually weakens; lacunae help identify constraints on कर्तृत्व without encouraging identification with deficiency.

decisions.title: Veervrat, its structured process, and the app are distinct
decisions.summary: Veervrat is a संस्कार undertaken so that कर्तृत्वशक्तीचे स्वावलंबन increases; a structured process supports undertaking it, and the Veervrat app is the community's digital platform. Veervrat itself is neither the workflow nor the software.

decisions.title: Agency must be strengthened, not substituted
decisions.summary: The locus of judgment and action remains with the Vratarthi; the process, Vratamitra, app, AI, and community support development without replacing or owning the Vratarthi's agency.

decisions.title: Success is demonstrated developmental change
decisions.summary: Journey success is developmental change in how genuinely, consistently, and independently the chosen Sentence's quality or capability is present in life. Ratings, completion states, and metrics are evidence or proxies, not objectives; Challenge cardinality remains open.

decisions.title: Notifications and re-engagement support self-directed action
decisions.summary: As an application of PD-004, notifications may inform or remind the Vratarthi about intentions they already own, but must not become a source of dependency or optimize for compulsive engagement, streak anxiety, artificial urgency, or repeated-prompt dependence. This constrains behavior without banning reminders or re-engagement.

decisions.title: Primary Vratamitra relationship lifecycle
decisions.summary: A Vratarthi has at most one active Primary Vratamitra and one pending invitation. The relationship begins on acceptance; either party may end it independently, preserving history and contributions. Invitation history is retained, and former-Primary status alone grants no continuing broad Primary-level access; feature-specific artifact access remains deferred under DT-002.

decisions.title: Journey Vratamitra relationship lifecycle
decisions.summary: Journey guidance uses distinct Primary-derived and specific-person modes. Primary-derived guidance follows the current active Primary without separate Journey acceptance; specific-person guidance requires explicit acceptance and persists independently of Primary changes. Active Journeys may switch modes. Ending and completion preserve history and contributions; completed-Journey and artifact access remain deferred under DT-002. Ending a specific-person relationship during an active Journey leaves it unguided/solo without automatic Primary fallback; an explicit later choice may restore guidance.

decisions.title: Vratamitra multiplicity, coexistence, and capacity
decisions.summary: A person may guide multiple Vratarthis and Journeys while undertaking their own Veervrat. Primary and explicitly chosen specific-person Journey relationships may coexist for the same pair. Any Vratarthi may serve without a separate eligibility gate at this stage, but cannot guide themselves. There is no arbitrary hard numerical guidance cap; capacity rests with human judgment.

decisions.title: Actor inventory and role structure
decisions.summary: Every signed-in user is a Vratarthi; an unsigned-in Public Visitor is not yet a Vratarthi in the product. Vratamitra, Curator, Moderator, and Admin are additional roles/capabilities a Vratarthi may hold; Primary and Journey Vratamitra describe guidance relationships. Identity/account ontology and exact operational permissions remain deferred.
decisions.rationale: PD-011 preserves the actor purposes and signed-in participation intention while establishing registration-based persistent Vratarthi identity, Public Visitor access while logged out, and granted versus contextual roles.

decisions.title: Identity, Participation, and Role Ontology
decisions.summary: Each registered account represents exactly one persistent Vratarthi and automatically has a Profile. Login/logout changes authentication/access state, not Vratarthi identity. Multiple accounts per human and authentication methods per account are allowed without real-world uniqueness enforcement or a separate Person entity. Curator/Moderator/Admin are granted capabilities; guidance roles derive from accepted relationships. Invitations may precede recipient registration, which does not itself accept a guidance relationship.
decisions.rationale: Supersedes PD-010 to clarify persistent registration-based identity while preserving its actor purposes, coexistence, and the intention that every signed-in user is a Vratarthi.

decisions.title: व्रतपालन and समाजाभिमुखता within the North Star
decisions.summary: Additive philosophical refinement: व्रतपालन / संकल्पपालन is constitutive of the संस्कार; गुणसंवर्धन is central, उणीवा can guide developmental direction, and दोषापनयन occurs through cultivating relevant qualities. Overcoming क्षुद्र हृदयदौर्बल्य serves the unchanged North Star. समाजाभिमुखता is essential without compulsory social service or equating observability with social orientation.
decisions.rationale: Explicit user-confirmed PH-003 interpretation, distinguished from original literature; preserves PD-001 through PD-006.

decisions.title: Developmental catalogs and स्वमूल्यांकन
decisions.summary: Shared curated गुण, उपगुण, उणीवा, and गुणदर्शक विधाने: each उपगुण has one गुण and each विधान one उपगुण; उणीव–उपगुण is many-to-many with no direct उणीव–विधान mapping. Repeatable point-in-time self-assessment evaluates all statements under the selected उणीव's associated उपगुण, independently of a Journey. Naming is provisional; personal catalogs are uncommitted candidates.

decisions.title: Journey and अनुभव / संकल्प / आव्हान ontology
decisions.summary: A Vratarthi's Journey undertakes one shared विधान, may start without assessment or उणीव, and preserves historical discovery contexts. Shared undertaking catalog items (earlier shared suggestions, clarified by PD-023) relate many-to-many to statements; multiple personal undertakings and custom suggestions retain Vratarthi authority. A completed Journey conceptually requires a completed संकल्प; अनुभव and आव्हान are optional. Lifecycle and broader progression were deferred at PH-003; their conceptual scope is now resolved by PD-016–PD-020.

decisions.title: Resource and personal-information boundaries
decisions.summary: Resources are accessible learning/development material, including foundational Handbook and Pothi; formats do not compel distinct entity types or developmental links. Journeys and assessments belong to the Vratarthi, not Profile. Authored content is not automatically curated Resources; detailed structure, community features, permissions, and presentation remain deferred.

decisions.title: Journey initiation, discovery, lifecycle, and engagement
decisions.summary: One unconcluded Journey per Vratarthi–विधान; conscious additional discovery contexts. Ongoing/Deliberately Paused/Completed/Discontinued lifecycle is separate from observed Active/Inactive engagement. Explicit pause/resume preserves individual undertaking pause conditions; meaningful recorded Vratarthi activity, not viewing or guide activity alone, clears inactivity.

decisions.title: Undertaking lifecycle, definition, revision, and conclusion
decisions.summary: Prose-first अनुभव/संकल्प/आव्हान definitions share flexible lifecycle, with reason/outcome distinct. Optional intermediate logging and guide participation, prospective traceable revisions, Vratarthi authority, and honest conclusion accounts preserve agency. Never-started work closed solely by parent conclusion has a narrow account exception.

decisions.title: Journey conclusion, self-review, and terminal guidance
decisions.summary: Completion requires a completed संकल्प, appropriate unfinished-work handling, final self-review, and requesting effective Journey Vratamitra perspective when applicable; response/approval is not required. Discontinuation requires self-review but not completion minimum or a feedback request. Both terminal states preserve history and end Journey guidance/pending invitations without ending the underlying Primary relationship.
decisions.rationale: Explicit additive extension of PD-008's completion consequences to discontinuation; guidance modes and existing relationship semantics are preserved.

decisions.title: Initial assessment and recommendation model
decisions.summary: Optional assessment uses Never/Sometimes/Often/Always universally and recommends comparatively lower ratings even when all are Often/Always; any assessed विधान may be chosen. Direct browsing also permits Journey initiation/reuse. Alternative scales and contextual algorithms remain uncommitted candidates.

decisions.title: Continuous development without aggregate progression gates
decisions.summary: Current scope is continuous development through individual Journeys, without mandatory aggregate counts/targets, levels, eligibility/readiness thresholds, or a distinct formal undertaking milestone. Such a milestone remains an uncommitted candidate, not a philosophical exclusion from the wider tradition.

decisions.title: Knowledge purpose, standing, and stewardship
decisions.summary: Knowledge supports understanding Veervrat, personal development, and independent broader learning. Authorship, foundational/official standing, curation, and featuring are distinct; Curators steward curated material through a simple publishing lifecycle without mandatory multi-person approval or a dedicated Vratarthi submission/promotion workflow. Detailed authority and access remain deferred.

decisions.title: Resource structure, classification, and reference continuity
decisions.summary: Generic Resources have optional ordered, nested, individually referenceable Sections. Centrally managed extensible types/tags are distinct from optional explicit many-to-many developmental associations. Internal/external material may coexist. References follow current content without mandatory Resource version history; unavailable material does not erase personal content. No separate Collection is in current scope.

decisions.title: Undertaking catalog terminology and stewardship
decisions.summary: Earlier shared/catalog suggestions mean Curator-managed undertaking catalog items, distinct from personal undertakings and recommendations. Relevant catalog access suffices without an undertaking recommendation engine or dedicated Vratarthi submission/promotion workflow. Resources are distinct; optional prose references do not create a formal Resource–Undertaking association model.
decisions.rationale: Explicit user-confirmed terminology clarification of PD-014/017, preserving their relationships, personal revision history, and Vratarthi authority; PD-019 assessment recommendations are unchanged.

decisions.title: Optional explanatory description
decisions.summary: A गुणदर्शक विधान may have an optional explanatory description belonging to it, not a separate assessed statement, assessment entity, or required Resource. No mandatory backfill, relationship, assessment-inclusion, scale, or Journey-anchor change is introduced.
decisions.rationale: Explicit compatible PH-005 addition to PD-013, not supersession of the developmental ontology.
